transcript.text: Give me 60 seconds and you will never be poor again.
Before you go to sleep tonight, just for 60 seconds,
I want you to stop repeating the identity that keeps you broke.
I want you to stop going to bed thinking nothing works for me
or I'm behind or I hope one day my life changes
because your subconscious mind
listens most right before you sleep.
That's when your identity becomes programmable.
So for 60 seconds tonight,
I want you to repeat this instead.
Money comes to me easily
because I no longer reject wealth internally.
I am safe being powerful, visible and successful.
I release the identity that romanticizes struggle.
I become the kind of person
who naturally attracts opportunities, money and expansion.
My reality is reorganizing itself in my favor.
The version of me who already has everything that I want
already exists.
And every day I become more emotionally aligned with her.
I expect miracles, I expect abundance,
I expect my life to change
because poor people don't just have poor bank accounts,
they have poor identities.
And the moment you change your identity,
your reality starts trying to catch up.
